subject: Mutual Action Plan — owners & timeline confirmation needed

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan — owners & timeline confirmation needed

Alex — great to meet today. Per our call I’m attaching the Mutual Action Plan (MPA) we discussed so you can share with your stakeholders. Quick recap and asks: 

- Goal: 6-week evaluation to validate latency/cost targets for user-facing recommendation API.
- Proposed pilot scope: 50K monthly active requests, top-5 recommendation flows.
- Key milestones (proposed):
  • Week 0: Kickoff + test dataset handoff (owner: Acme eng)
  • Week 1–2: Integration & smoke tests (owner: Acme eng / Redwood support)
  • Week 3–4: Load run + perf tuning (owner: Redwood infra)
  • Week 5–6: Acceptance + handover (owner: Acme product)

As next steps I asked for named owners and dates so we can lock capacity and schedule a Dedicated pool if needed. Can you confirm the owners next to each milestone and whether the proposed timeline still fits your end-of-quarter priorities? If it helps I’ve attached a one-page MPA summary and the editable spreadsheet (Acme_MPA_v1.xlsx).

Action requested: Reply with owners + preferred kickoff week by EOD next Thu (2026-09-24). If priority shifted, let me know rough timing and we’ll propose an alternate rollout.

Attachments: Acme_MPA_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), MPA_summary.pdf (one-pager)

Thanks,
Ben

1) Named owner for the kickoff/test dataset handoff (we suggested an engineering lead).

• Can you confirm who at Acme will own the dataset handoff and integration (name + email)?
